title: Bumps, heat soak, and low-clearance parking issues
summary: Feedback in this topic is mostly undetermined and spans several unrelated situations including cabin heat soak, underground parking behavior, bump harshness, and low-clearance contact.

negative.summary: The negative feedback complains that the sunroof allows too much heat to build up in the cabin.

mixed.summary: The mixed feedback says the always-on headlights are useful in general but become frustrating in underground parking where drivers want an option to switch them off.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention bump harshness, scraping in ramps or low garages, and activation behavior, but the excerpts do not provide enough context to confirm a clear sentiment.

limitations: The topic cluster mixes unrelated subjects rather than one coherent issue.
Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so the evidence is thin for drawing a clear thematic conclusion.
